feed.title: NPR Topics: Politics
feed.subtitle: NPR's expanded coverage of U.S. and world politics, the latest news from Congress and the White House and elections.

entry.title: DOJ charges 28 in California with voting crimes as election tensions escalate
entry.summary: The DOJ also filed an emergency request in federal court to stop California from processing ballots returned by people on the voter rolls the federal government says are "likely noncitizens."

entry.title: Judge chastises Trump administration plan to push ahead overhaul of DC golf course
entry.summary: The Trump administration wants to turn a historic public golf course into championship links. Despite a judge's order, hundreds of trees were cut down to make way for the renovation.

entry.title: 2026 midterms could be the most expensive on record. And, Macron condemns protests
entry.summary: More than $15 billion has been raised in this year's midterm elections. And, France's president is condemning the violent protests erupting across the country.

entry.title: Rep. Don Beyer, D-Va., on Trump waiving sanctions on Russia
entry.summary: NPR's Leila Fadel asks Democratic Rep. Don Beyer of Virginia about President Trump's decision to waive new sanctions on Russia.

entry.title: The real reason it's going to take a while to know who won in some midterm races
entry.summary: Hint: It's not only because California counts slowly.

entry.title: Michigan's Democratic Senate candidate Abdul El-Sayed campaigns in GOP stronghold
entry.summary: Michigan's Democratic U.S. Senate candidate Abdul El-Sayed is campaigning in the GOP stronghold of Michigan's Upper Peninsula, an area that hasn't voted for a Democrat in Congress in over a decade.

entry.title: What does a White House press secretary do?
entry.summary: Katie Zacharia's short time as White House press secretary has brought renewed attention to the high-profile role.

entry.title: Congress reacts to executive order exempting Russia from economic sanctions
entry.summary: NPR's Eric McDaniel reports on how Congress has reacted to President Trump's executive order exempting Russia from economic sanctions.

entry.title: Greensboro, NC students protest the absence of early voting sites on campus
entry.summary: NPR's Ayesha Rascoe talks to North Carolina A&T student Shia Rozier about disappointment with early voting sites in Greensboro.

entry.title: What role does the White House Press Secretary play in the Trump era?
entry.summary: NPR's Ayesha Rascoe asks Adm. John Kirby, who had spokesperson roles in the Obama and Biden administrations, about the utility of the role of the White House Press Secretary.
